---
name: Reproduction or implementation clarification
about: Describe a reproducible discrepancy, formula question, or scope issue
---
Please give the candidate version, CPU environment, exact command, expected and
observed behavior, and a minimal synthetic example. Identify whether the issue
concerns a paper statement, implementation assumption, or historical table.
Do not attach credentials, restricted model weights, personal data or raw private
records. No response time or full reproduction support is promised.
